title: Real Estate Agent Tie-up in Pondicherry | Namma Pondy
description: Agents, brokers and promoters in Puducherry: share deals through co-broking, offer our layouts to buyers and get documents checked. Apply for a tie-up.
h1: Real Estate Agent and Promoter Tie-ups in Pondicherry
lead: Most deals in this district die because the two halves never met — one broker has the buyer, another has the property, and neither trusts the other enough to share. We would rather split a commission than lose a deal.
wa: Hi, I am an agent/promoter in ___ and I want to discuss a tie-up

blocks.h: What a tie-up with us means
bullets: Co-broking: you bring one side, we bring the other, and the commission is shared on a written understanding
Access to the [layouts we develop](/our-projects), to offer your own buyers
Document verification support from our office before a deal goes too far
For promoters and builders: your project filmed and published on our page
Partner rates on [reel shoots](/instagram-reel-shoot), and a partners' group for live requirements

items.d: Name, area, how long you have been working and what you handle.
We would rather meet than sign something over the phone.
Commission share, who does what, how buyers are introduced.
Requirements go into the partners' group as they come in.

blocks.text: Looking for a lead subscription or a listing account? That is The Plot One, our property platform. This page is for working together on deals.
